scope: Offline Chromium with synthetic data and actual deployed source files. Not authenticated production E2E or physical iPhone.
counter_definition: MutationObserver callback invocations during a one-second idle interval after warmup; not unique DOM mutations, CPU percentage or rendered frames.
header_experiment: Remove inherited grid-column, grid-row and flex-direction declarations from existing .chatHeading CSS rules in an isolated CSSOM. This is diagnostic intervention, not a shipped repair.
limitations: Does not establish that every reported iOS freeze has the same sole cause.
No authenticated browser session or real user data was used in these experiments.
No full backend, security, load or physical-device acceptance is claimed.
Diagnostic recorder completion is not a product PASS.
